stages.goal: Define learning target and scope boundaries.
entry_criteria: Target subsystem and repository scope declared.
exit_criteria: At least one candidate already-upstreamed Qualcomm audio target identified.

stages.goal: Index source corpus and file families.
exit_criteria: Index coverage for declared scope is complete.
fail_closed_conditions: Missing core file family index for declared scope.

stages.goal: Extract static structure and symbol relationships.
exit_criteria: Static structure relationships captured with evidence references.
fail_closed_conditions: Symbol relationships reported without source evidence.

stages.goal: Capture review history and maintainer feedback patterns.
exit_criteria: History signals linked to studied scope.
DTS semantic entities mapped to shared ontology terms.

stages.goal: Extract binding constraints and schema semantics.
exit_criteria: YAML semantics connected to DTS and driver structure.
fail_closed_conditions: Schema interpretation lacks direct binding evidence.

stages.goal: Extract compile-time feature and dependency semantics.
exit_criteria: Compile-time constraints linked to studied subsystem behavior.
fail_closed_conditions: Feature dependency assertions without Kconfig evidence.

stages.goal: Extract build integration and object composition semantics.
exit_criteria: Build composition is mapped into subsystem understanding.
fail_closed_conditions: Build structure claims without Makefile evidence.

stages.goal: Correlate learned static semantics with Track A runtime truth.
entry_criteria: DTS_ANALYZED, YAML_ANALYZED, KCONFIG_ANALYZED, and MAKEFILE_ANALYZED completed.
exit_criteria: At least one runtime-backed semantic correlation established.
fail_closed_conditions: Runtime correlation attempted with no Track A evidence references.

stages.goal: Build advisory semantic model aligned to shared ontology.
exit_criteria: Semantic model contains evidence references and confidence accounting.
fail_closed_conditions: Semantic model introduces new ontology instead of reusing shared ontology.

stages.goal: Extract candidate reusable framework and review patterns.
exit_criteria: Candidate patterns are explicitly tagged as reusable or unverified.

stages.goal: Validate that extracted patterns are reusable across multiple already-upstreamed Qualcomm platforms.
exit_criteria: Each promoted pattern is observed across at least 2 already-upstreamed Qualcomm platforms.
Promoted patterns are classified reusable rather than board-specific.
fail_closed_conditions: Pattern appears on only one platform.
Pattern remains board-specific but is marked reusable.

stages.goal: Publish advisory-only understanding completion for learning progress.
exit_criteria: Understanding is certified as advisory only.
No patch generation, conversion, or submission action is triggered.
fail_closed_conditions: Any delivery or conversion action attempted from this stage.
